items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I've heard the name of it.

ctx.x: Another thing, I've seen somebody told me that your brother might have gone up with Tigg Chambers. Do you remember Tigg Chambers ever?

Well, they went up too. They had a band, Tick Chambers, let's see what they had, but they came up after. No one else. No, they came up after that, see. Because all together at one time there was three bands up there from the all-in. Tigg Chambers, Ernest Kelly was playing a trombone I think. I've heard the name of it.
